method.combination: Keep the 960 ms incumbent when it reports a range. Else choose the largest absolute excess over its length-specific point.
method.inputs: Use clean exact earlier copies, hold the clock fixed, add matched rain and train noise at -5 dB.
method.processing_guard: Compare with the existing twelve-second broad frequency balance rule, using its same three sections over six seconds.
method.selection: For each length, use the maximum response on matched ordinary development cases across all three backgrounds.
